title: A/R Collection forgets the sort between visits
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a customer with two overdue invoices on today's date, with different open balances, so sorting by Open Balance changes their order.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Open Balance" header.
  2. Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu).
  3. Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The rows sort by Open Balance, largest first.

Step 2:

  • Sales By Customer opens.

Step 3:

  • A/R Collection opens in its opening order again, with "Date" marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading).
  • The Open Balance sort is not remembered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R8: “The sort is not remembered between visits: opening the report again starts from Story 1's order.”
  • S1-R7: “The column the report opened on is marked as sorted: the name column on the Summaries and Detail reports, the Date column on Collection and Unpaid Invoices.”
